definition: Seconds from the nearest EIA Weekly Petroleum Status Report, Wednesday 10:30 New York time, negative before it and positive after.
boundaries: New York time follows its daylight-saving rule. The weeks EIA moves the release for a holiday are not modelled, so in those weeks the value measures from the standard Wednesday. It is a fixed clock, not the report's numbers. Bars without a time are missing. QML's unit runtime does not yet pass a bars input its time, so inside a unit this value stays missing until it does.
recognition: Oil units go flat before the Wednesday inventory report.

sources.quote: will be at 10:30 a.m. eastern time on Wednesday

golden.reference: local event times from zoneinfo (the IANA tz database), in qml/tests/golden/beyond-fx/reference_run.py
